test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_prewhere_coalesced_runs.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS k, toUInt8(cityHash64(number) % 100) AS u, toUInt32(cityHash64(number, 1)) AS u32, cityHash64(number, 2) AS u64 FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(u32), sum(u64) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_coalesced_runs.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE u < 5 FORMAT Null
